title: Marcos was absolutely amazing!
text: Our photographer Marcos, was absolutely fantastic. He was so bubbly and friendly, and knew all the perfect spots to capture our perfect photos. I would highly recommend booking him, great experience and value.
author: Dillon_P

title: Great photographer
text: Marco was so friendly and helpful! He knew a bunch of good places, was very patient, and took beautiful photos of my whole family. Amazing experience
author: JoEnid_A

title: Highly recommend this...
text: Highly recommend this experience. Rodri took great photos and knew all the best spots around La Sagrada Família to avoid the crowds. The family photos turned out great and were extremely easy to download after the shoot. Well worth the cost!
author: Casey_C

title: Great experience, photos...
text: Great experience, photos came out perfect for the occasion! Photographer gave great suggestions/recommendations for poses and start time. Would highly recommend!
author: Brent_C

title: This was a great...
text: This was a great experience with beautiful photos.  Borja was very friendly and talented.  Would recommend!!
author: Marla_D

title: Excellent way to capture...
text: Excellent way to capture memories of Barcelona.  Photos were great. Definitely worth it.  Highly recommended.
author: Obadiah_E

title: Photo shoot with Borja!
text: Our photo shoot was awesome.  Borja was a great photographer and took some awesome pictures of us. If you are considering a photo shoot I highly suggest this one!  My husband and I got tired of selfie shots and have been booking photo shoots in iconic places we visit. No disappointments with this shoot!  Borja was great!
author: Cindy_C

title: The amazing view of Sagrada Família.
text: Amazing experienced and Borja was fantastic with his craft, he was patience during the shoot and he managed all the angle very well. Well done to him and keep up the good work. I will highly recommend him to my friends and other family circle. Worth the money,absolutely unforgettable experienced to us.
author: Eric_N

title: Dani is a professional!
text: Dani is a dedicated and professional photographer!  He works so hard to take pictures which are full of characters!  I had such a wonderful time having pictures taken by him.
author: Ying_Y

title: Excellent
text: Borja was amazing! He was so good with the kids and helping us find the perfect spot/pose! We loved every picture he took! He was patient, responsive and easy to communicate with!
author: Ana_C
